essence: Sixteen mantra letters are to be drawn in the middle and related positions.
The drawing extends as far as each particular use requires.
Siddhalakshmi is always invoked for accomplishment of all desires.
Beginning with all women, the world was made subject.
That one fashioned his own body sixfold for amusement.
